result.summary: Fixes binary verification in `contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py` so only distinct, non-revoked signatures from trusted keys satisfy `--min-good-sigs`. It extracts primary and subkey fingerprints from GnuPG `VALIDSIG` status lines to match against `--trusted-keys` and deduplicate signers by primary key fingerprint.
result.problem: `verify_shasums_signature` previously calculated `num_trusted = len(good_trusted) + len(good_untrusted)` (and added all expired keys under `--allow-expired`), allowing valid signatures from untrusted keys in a user's GPG keyring to satisfy `--min-good-sigs`. Furthermore, `--trusted-keys` could not match against full 40-character fingerprints and did not deduplicate multiple signatures sharing a primary key.
evidence: Commit d1c576b365 and PR description: 'verify_shasums_signature previously added len(good_untrusted) (and all expired signatures under --allow-expired) into num_trusted, allowing valid signatures from untrusted keys in the local keyring to satisfy --min-good-sigs even when --trusted-keys did not match any signer.'
result.changed_since_previous: Minor updates to fingerprint normalization and whitespace handling when parsing `--trusted-keys`, and expanded log messages detailing untrusted keys when the threshold is not reached.
result.card: Fixes a verification flaw in `contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py` where signatures from untrusted keys in the local GPG keyring were added to `num_trusted` and could satisfy `--min-good-sigs`. Only distinct, non-revoked signers matching local GPG trust or `--trusted-keys` now count toward the quorum. It also parses `VALIDSIG` lines to match full 40-character fingerprints and deduplicates multiple signatures made under the same primary key.

risk.why: It only touches a developer/user verification script in `contrib/`, where a bug would cause false passes or failures when verifying release binaries.
